summary: Iteration 51 — End-to-end test of 5 prompts: Section 45 (reports/against-me + reports/mine), Section 44 NavBar (firstName + conditional Plans), Section 46 Comunidad TabBar fixed, Section 47 UserAvatar/MentionedText, Section 48 SplashScreen, ProviderDashboard eCard iframe modal + removed ProviderLeftNav. Backend pytest 7/7 passed; frontend Playwright 14/15 passed; 1 SplashScreen reduced-motion edge case is a doc-vs-code inconsistency (debug ?splash=1 bypasses prefers-reduced-motion).

ui_bugs.issue: Doc comment says 'Honors prefers-reduced-motion by simply not rendering', but the debug ?splash=1 override bypasses the reduced-motion check (line 55-56). Either fix doc comment or AND-in `!_reducedMotion()` to the debug branch.

issues: React hydration warning: 'In HTML, <option> cannot be a child of <span>' — appears in console on /dashboard/provider. Pre-existing, but visible. Search for select/option wrapped in a <span> in ProviderDashboard.

action_items: (Optional) Decide whether ?splash=1 debug override should still honor prefers-reduced-motion; if yes, change line 55 of SplashScreen.jsx to `const shouldShow = !_reducedMotion() && (debugForce || (_isMobile() && _isStandalone() && !_isOnCooldown()));`. If no, update the docblock on line 16 to clarify the debug-flag bypass.
(Optional) Investigate hydration warning '<option> cannot be a child of <span>' originating from ProviderDashboard (App.js line 143). Not from this iteration's changes but surfaces in console.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /reports/against-me correctly: (a) requires auth (401), (b) filters by target_id == current user, (c) drops reporter_id/email/name keys, (d) masks pending description with '(En revisión, oculto al destinatario)', (e) returns full description once status flips to resolved/dismissed — all verified end-to-end via test_iter51_section45_reports_against.py.

Header.jsx conditional render of nav-plans is correct: logged-out users see it (count=1), logged-in users hide it (count=0). nav-dashboard text shows real first name 'María' (verified ⚙María button text), and href routes properly to /dashboard/provider.
ComunidadLayout TabBar: useSmartNav was removed — bounding box stays at y=80 even after scrolling 1500px down (was sticking at y=80 with no drift), confirming position:fixed behavior.

ProviderDashboard: ProviderLeftNav element NOT present (count=0); 'Ver mi eCard' is rendered as a <button> with NO target attribute; clicking opens [data-testid='ecard-preview-modal'] with iframe inside; modal closes on Escape AND on backdrop click; 'Abrir en pestaña' link has target='_blank'.

MentionedText regex `/(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_.])@([a-zA-Z0-9_.]{3,30})/g` correctly excludes emails because the `[^a-zA-Z0-9_.]` lookbehind class rejects emails where alphanumeric local-part char precedes `@`. Verified no leaked /u/{local} link in any post containing an email.
seed_data_creation: Created and resolved 1 TEST_iter51 report (client→provider) during test_against_me_reporter_identity_redacted; the report remains in DB with status=resolved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL is https://verified-providers-2.preview.emergentagent.com (NOT amano-revival.preview.emergentagent.com — that one 404s). Auth rate-limit is 8 req/min on /api/auth/login, so cache sessions via module-scoped fixtures. ?splash=1 forces splash render on mobile viewports (width<768) regardless of prefers-reduced-motion — this is debug bypass behavior. The TEST_iter51 resolved report against demo.provider can be reused for /reports/against-me 'resolved keeps description' tests.
rca of the issue: SplashScreen prefers-reduced-motion: the boolean logic `debugForce || (_isMobile() && _isStandalone() && !_reducedMotion() && !_isOnCooldown())` makes the debug query param a hard override that ignores reduced-motion. The natural mobile-PWA flow does respect reduced-motion correctly. Mitigation: either factor `_reducedMotion()` out as a global short-circuit before the disjunction, or update the JSDoc to state that the debug flag intentionally bypasses motion-preferences for QA.
